notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Imagecrafter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Niv-Mizzet to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcom triggers, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 3.
